security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, sample Bash snippets, sample URLs, and relative documentation links. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, hidden installation step, or malicious network behavior was found in SKILL.md. The skill still relies on normal workspace reads, searches, and optional local validation commands for documentation review.

content.value_statement: Documentation can drift as files, links, examples, and modules change. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured validation.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether modules and user guides have expected documentation coverage.
Reviews Markdown structure, heading hierarchy, list formatting, and code block language labels.
Finds broken or inconsistent internal links and reports likely fixes.
Flags stale status text, outdated statistics, and inconsistent terminology.
Produces prioritized documentation reports with severity, impact, and suggested fixes.
Supports quick checks, full audits, link checks, and module coverage reviews.
limitations: The guidance is tailored to the Logseq Template Graph repository structure.
External link validation may require network access and can be skipped offline.
It does not guarantee that every code example is safe to execute.
It reports documentation issues but does not rewrite files unless the user asks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Documentation
use_cases.description: Check guides, module READMEs, links, and examples before a release branch is finalized.

use_cases.title: Audit Module Coverage
use_cases.description: Identify missing README files and weak module explanations across the source tree.

use_cases.title: Review Documentation Quality
use_cases.description: Find formatting, terminology, and outdated status issues during routine documentation maintenance.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quick Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for the most visible documentation issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate the documentation in this repository. Report the top issues, affected files, and quick fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Links
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for broken internal and external references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check documentation links. Separate internal and external links, report broken targets, and suggest corrected destinations.

prompt_templates.title: Measure Module Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for source module documentation completeness.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit module documentation coverage. List modules with missing or weak README files and rank fixes by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Documentation Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release readiness review across quality categories.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full documentation audit for completeness, accuracy, formatting, links, coverage, and consistency. Provide prioritized recommendations.

output_examples.output: Overall status: good. Main issues: one missing module README, one broken installation link, and two code blocks without language labels.
Found one broken external link and one missing internal target. Suggested fixes include a replacement download URL and a corrected setup guide path.
Module README coverage is mostly complete. The highest priority gap is the largest undocumented module, followed by incomplete examples.

best_practices: Run quick checks before small documentation edits and full audits before releases.
Review suggested shell or network checks before executing them in a repository.
Prioritize broken links, missing core module docs, and inaccurate commands first.
anti_patterns: Do not execute arbitrary code examples from documentation without reviewing them first.
Do not treat sample counts or report examples as verified project facts.
Do not publish fixes without checking that paths and anchors exist.

faq.question: What documentation does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Logseq Template Graph guides, module READMEs, command docs, skill docs, links, examples, and formatting.

faq.question: Can it find broken links?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the agent to separate internal and external links, validate targets, and suggest corrections.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Only external URL checks need network access. Local documentation checks can run without network access.

faq.question: Will it edit documentation automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed to report issues and fixes unless the user asks for edits.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it limited to one repository?
faq.answer: Its checklist is specific to Logseq Template Graph, but many review categories apply to similar Markdown projects.
